Thanks for the heads-up — read the draft. High-level comments and proposed snippets below (comments written to be dropped directly into the DPA):

1) SCC insertion: we will reference the standard 2021 SCCs (Controller-Processor Module) and include a short confirmatory clause: "The Parties agree that the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (2021) shall apply to transfers of Personal Data and are incorporated by reference into this DPA."

2) Controller/Processor: For the Order Form, propose a definition table mapping Services => Role. Example: "Hosted API (Redwood-hosted model) = Processor; Private (customer-managed VPC or on‑prem) = Processor with data residency obligations in Order Form; Customer remains Controller."

3) Subprocessors & KMS: Acceptable approach — KMS/HSM add-on will be documented in Order Form; subprocessor approval window: propose 14 days notice for non-critical subprocessors; for cryptographic key custodians we treat as critical and require prior written consent.

4) Transfer-impact addendum: propose a one‑page TIA referencing regional routing policy and fallback order: (1) route to customer-preferred region, (2) failover to nearest region with compatible legal basis, (3) if neither available, initiate documented customer notice and option to pause replication.

I attached a redline file with inline edits (ben_redline_comments.docx). From a risk POV, the KMS exception is the biggest negotiation lever — if Jade insists on unrestricted KMS options we should require a commercial commitment to Dedicated/Private.

—Ben
